contact.metadataDescription: Get in touch about products, supply, distribution, manufacturing partnerships or investment. AcresxManna replies within two working days.

privacy.metadataDescription: How AcresxManna collects, uses, stores and protects personal data from contact forms, enquiries and newsletter sign-ups.
privacy.heading: How we look after your information.
privacy.intro: Last updated: October 2026. This policy explains how AcresxManna handles personal information collected through this website. It is written in plain language and applies to visitors in Nigeria, the United Kingdom and elsewhere.
privacy.whoWeAreBody: AcresxManna Ltd is the Nigerian entity that manufactures, signs customer contracts and exports products. UncleTobi.Shop is the UK-facing entity that invoices buyers and operates a warehouse and office in Hertford, United Kingdom. Together, we are the data controllers for information submitted through this site.
privacy.whoWeAreContact: For any privacy question, contact us at <link>info@acresxmanna.com</link>.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect only the information you choose to share with us:
privacy.collectItem1: Contact-form submissions: name, email, company or organisation, enquiry type and message.
privacy.collectItem2: Supplier and distributor applications: name, business or farm name, location, commodities, estimated volumes and season, and message.
privacy.collectItem3: Product enquiries: name, email, company and message.
privacy.collectItem5: Technical data such as IP address, device type and browser, collected automatically by analytics tools only after you give consent.
privacy.whyHeading: Why we collect it and on what basis
privacy.whyItem1: Reply to your enquiry or application.
privacy.whyItem3: Send newsletter updates only when you have asked to receive them.
privacy.whyItem4: Improve the website and understand how it is used.
privacy.whyBasis: We process this information based on your consent (for newsletter and analytics), our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries, and our legal obligations.
privacy.shareBody: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers acting on our behalf, including hosting, email, CRM and analytics providers. We may also share information with professional advisers or authorities where required by law.
privacy.transfersBody: Your information may be processed in Nigeria, the United Kingdom and other countries where our service providers operate. We use appropriate safeguards to protect your information when it is transferred across borders.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep enquiry and application records for as long as needed to manage the relationship and meet legal obligations. Newsletter records are kept until you unsubscribe. We review and delete personal data on a regular schedule when it is no longer needed.
privacy.securityBody: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, including secure hosting, access controls and regular reviews. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we work to protect your data to the best of our ability.
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, object to or restrict the processing of your personal data, and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at <link>info@acresxmanna.com</link>.
privacy.complaintsBody: If you are not satisfied with how we handle your information, you can contact us at <link>info@acresxmanna.com</link>. You may also have the right to complain to a data protection authority in your country.
privacy.cookiesBody: For information about cookies, see our <link>Cookie Policy</link>. This website is not aimed at children and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the date at the top of this page and, where appropriate, notify you by email or through the website.

terms.metadataDescription: Terms governing the use of the AcresxManna website, including acceptable use, intellectual property and disclaimers.
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Last updated: October 2026. These terms govern your use of the AcresxManna website. By accessing or using this site, you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: This website is intended for businesses and individuals interested in AcresxManna's products, services and partnerships. You may use the site for lawful purposes only and in accordance with these terms.
terms.acceptableItem1: Use the site for any unlawful purpose or in a way that could damage, disable or impair the site.
terms.acceptableItem2: Attempt to gain unauthorised access to the site, its systems or data.
terms.acceptableItem3: Use automated tools to scrape, copy or reproduce content without permission.
terms.acceptableItem4: Submit false, misleading or harmful information through any form on the site.
terms.ipBody: All content on this website, including text, logos, images, graphics and software, is owned by AcresxManna or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws. You may view and share content for personal, non-commercial use, but you may not reproduce, modify or distribute it without our written permission.
terms.accuracyBody: The content on this site is provided for general information purposes only and may change without notice. It is not an offer to sell or a guarantee of product availability. Product information, specifications and availability are indicative until confirmed in writing by AcresxManna.
terms.linksBody: This site may contain links to third-party websites, including brand websites and social media. We are not responsible for the content or practices of those sites.
terms.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, AcresxManna is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, this website. This does not exclude or limit liability where prohibited by law.
terms.governingLawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Nigeria and the United Kingdom, as applicable. Disputes will be handled in the appropriate courts.
terms.contactBody: For questions about these terms, contact us at <link>info@acresxmanna.com</link>.

cookies.metadataDescription: Information about the cookies and similar technologies used on the AcresxManna website and how to manage them.
cookies.heading: Cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.intro: Last updated: October 2026. This policy explains what cookies are, which ones we use and how you can manage them.
cookies.whatAreCookiesBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and understand how the site is used. Similar technologies include local storage and pixel tags.
cookies.essentialPurpose: Required for the site to function, such as remembering your cookie consent choice and locale.
cookies.analyticsPurpose: Used to understand how visitors use the site, including pages visited and traffic sources. Only set after you consent.
cookies.essentialVsOptionalBody: Essential cookies are required for the website to work and cannot be switched off. Optional analytics cookies are only used when you give consent through our cookie banner.
cookies.consentBody: When you first visit the site, you will see a cookie banner. You can choose to accept all cookies, accept only essential cookies, or manage your settings. You can change your choice at any time using the Cookie settings link in the footer.
cookies.blockDeleteHeading: How to block or delete cookies
cookies.blockDeleteBody: You can block or delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note that blocking essential cookies may affect the functionality of the website.
cookies.contactBody: For questions about this Cookie Policy, contact us at <link>info@acresxmanna.com</link>.

becomeADistributor.metadataDescription: Discuss distribution of AcresxManna food products with our team.
becomeADistributor.title: Bring African-made food to your shelves.
becomeADistributor.intro: We welcome enquiries from retailers, wholesalers, distributors and importers interested in African food products and long-term commercial partnerships.
whatToKnow: Tell us who you serve, where you operate and the channels you sell through.
Let us know which products interest you and your expected order sizes.
Product information, availability, logistics and any sampling are confirmed individually.
steps: We discuss fit, volumes and logistics.
We agree a way to work together.
becomeADistributor.imageAlt: Pallets of packaged snacks and food items in dispatch depot
becomeADistributor.imageCaption: Palletized inventory and wholesale fulfillment for distribution partners.

becomeASupplier.metadataDescription: Tell AcresxManna about the agricultural commodities you grow, aggregate or trade.
becomeASupplier.title: Let’s source Africa’s harvest together.
becomeASupplier.intro: A dependable processing business needs dependable agricultural supply. If you grow, aggregate or trade agricultural commodities, we’d love to hear from you.
whatToKnow: We are interested in cassava, plantain, groundnuts and peanuts, hibiscus, and spice and seasoning ingredients.
Tell us about quality, origin, handling and the volumes you can supply through the season.
Prices, guaranteed volumes and payment terms are agreed only after we review the opportunity.
steps: We review quality, volume and timing.
We build the supply relationship step by step.
becomeASupplier.formIntro: Tell us what you grow or trade.
becomeASupplier.imageAlt: AcresxManna commercial plantain groves with drip irrigation
becomeASupplier.imageCaption: Sustainable sourcing and off-take partnerships with local growers.
